summary: Zhongchao Inc., a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its September 18, 2026 extraordinary general meeting held in New York. Holders of 2,569,435 Class A and 206,721 Class B ordinary shares, representing 209,290,435 votes of 215,387,755 eligible, established quorum. Shareholders approved a two-for-one share consolidation effective the tenth calendar day after passage, and a subsequent capital reduction cutting par value from US$1.488 to US$0.00001 per share, with the credit moved to a distributable reserve. These are routine capital-structure housekeeping measures, not a special situation; watch execution timing and any post-consolidation Nasdaq bid-price compliance.
